imputations: categories built from several acl18 codes (tv_media, socializing, sports_exercise, hobbies_and_games) take the union under independence, 1-prod(1-r), since the same person is counted under each code and published rates cannot be added
every cell is conditioned on both gender and age: each band maps to one published Eurostat band, so no age group is combined and no prior stands in

AC531 is published but not mapped — resting/time out: downtime rather than an interest, and its Japanese counterpart 休養・くつろぎ is ~4x wider (68.1% of men against 18.5%), so the pair would compare badly even though both publish it
AC221 is published but not mapped — free time study: Eurostat files it under Study, outside AC4-8
AC34 is published but not mapped — gardening and pet care: Eurostat files it under household care, outside AC4-8, though Japan counts gardening-as-pastime inside 趣味・娯楽
AC831 is 'listening to radio or recordings', so music listening lands in tv_media here while Japan counts it inside 趣味・娯楽

AC711_712_719_731_732_739 is explicitly 'except making handicraft products', which Eurostat files under household care (AC3_713); Japan's 趣味・娯楽 includes handicrafts, so hobbies_and_games is narrower here
AC514-516 'virtual social life' has no counterpart in Japan's 交際・付き合い
